statement: The function returns a byte vector r equal to the unique result of replacing, in the original text, every contiguous occurrence of each of these six tokens by the indicated byte: `"` -> byte 34 (quotation mark), `'` -> byte 39 (apostrophe), `&` -> byte 38 (ampersand), `>` -> byte 62 (greater-than sign), `<` -> byte 60 (less-than sign), `⁄` -> byte 47 (slash). Every byte of text not covered by such an occurrence is copied unchanged in its original order. Occurrences are those in the original text; a replacement byte that would form a new token is not rescanned or replaced. No two listed token occurrences can overlap (each token begins with byte 38 and contains no other byte 38), so r is well-defined and unique.
preconditions: 1 <= len(text) <= 100000. The bytes may be any values 0..255.

statement: The function returns some result r (a successful Result); it does not panic, fail, go out of bounds, or overflow on any input satisfying these preconditions.

Let Nq, Na, Nm, Ng, Nl, Nf be the numbers of contiguous occurrences in text of `"`, `'`, `&`, `>`, `<`, and `⁄`, respectively. Whenever the function returns r, len(r) = len(text) - 5*Nq - 5*Na - 4*Nm - 3*Ng - 3*Nl - 6*Nf.
The function returns r with len(r) = len(text) and r[i] = text[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(text).
preconditions: 1 <= len(text) <= 100000, and none of `"`, `'`, `&`, `>`, `<`, `⁄` occurs as a contiguous substring of text.

statement: Whenever the function returns r, the subcalls entity_parser(A) and entity_parser(B) also return, and r = entity_parser(A) ++ entity_parser(B) as byte-vector concatenation.
preconditions: 1 <= len(text) <= 100000. Let A and B be byte sequences with text = A ++ B and 1 <= len(A) < len(text). Assume that no contiguous occurrence of any of the six tokens in text starts at an index < len(A) and ends at an index >= len(A) (no token occurrence crosses the split between A and B).

statement: Let Nq, Na, Ng, Nl, Nf be the numbers of contiguous occurrences in text of `"`, `'`, `>`, `<`, and `⁄`, respectively, and let camps(x) be the number of bytes equal to 38 in byte sequence x. Whenever the function returns r, camps(r) = camps(text) - Nq - Na - Ng - Nl - Nf.

Let Nq, Na, Ng, Nl, Nf be the numbers of contiguous occurrences in text of `"`, `'`, `>`, `<`, and `⁄`, respectively. Let c34, c39, c62, c60, c47 count bytes equal to 34, 39, 62, 60, 47 in a byte sequence. Whenever the function returns r: c34(r) = c34(text) + Nq, c39(r) = c39(text) + Na, c62(r) = c62(text) + Ng, c60(r) = c60(text) + Nl, and c47(r) = c47(text) + Nf.

Let Nq, Na, Nm, Ng, Nl, Nf be the numbers of contiguous occurrences in text of `"`, `'`, `&`, `>`, `<`, and `⁄`, respectively, and let csemi(x) be the number of bytes equal to 59 in byte sequence x. Whenever the function returns r, csemi(r) = csemi(text) - (Nq + Na + Nm + Ng + Nl + Nf).
